i.norm: Verifies the human-readable {@link JsonAutoDetect.Value#toString()} output for the two predefined {@code Value} instances: the baseline "default visibility" instance and the "no overrides" instance (where every accessor visibility is {@code DEFAULT}).
Default visibility: public fields/getters/is-getters/creators, any setters, non-private scalar constructors.
No overrides: every accessor visibility is left as DEFAULT.
